title: Method for calibration of standardized test block for verification of scleroscope hardness testing equipments
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard prescribes the method for cahbration of standardized test blocks for verification of scleroscope hardness instruments.

clause_2_normative_references.title: Glossary of terms relating to methods of mechanical testing of metals

clause_3_terminology: Method for calibration of standardized test block for verification of scleroscope hardness testing equipments

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
